description: Implementation of the HpackDecoder class for HTTP/2 HPACK header decoding, including methods for decoding header blocks, error detection, and error reporting.

classes.name: HpackDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding HPACK header blocks in HTTP/2, managing decoding state, error detection, and reporting.

methods.name: set_max_string_size_bytes
methods.description: Sets the maximum size for strings in the header entry buffer.

methods.name: ApplyHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Applies a new header table size setting to the decoder state.

methods.name: StartDecodingBlock
methods.description: Begins decoding a new header block, resetting state and checking for errors.

methods.name: DecodeFragment
methods.description: Decodes a fragment of data as part of an HPACK header block, handling errors and forwarding entries.

methods.name: EndDecodingBlock
methods.description: Finalizes decoding of a header block, checking for truncation or errors.

methods.name: DetectError
methods.description: Checks if an error has been detected in the decoder.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error, updating internal state and notifying the listener.
